actions.label: WiFi
actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && nmcli radio wifi on || nmcli radio wifi off'
actions.update-command: sh -c '[[ $(nmcli radio wifi) == enabled ]] && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: Hotspot
actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && sudo /etc/init.d/S45hostapd start || sudo /etc/init.d/S45hostapd stop'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'pgrep hostapd && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: Flashlight
actions.update-command: sh -c 'cat /sys/class/leds/torch/brightness 2>/dev/null | grep 255 && echo true || echo false'
